title: Privacy Policy
intro: ARÔME HOUSE values trust and transparency in handling personal data. This policy explains the information used by our website, why it is used, how access is managed, and how you can contact us about your data.

sections.title: Definition
paragraphs: Personal data is information about an identified or identifiable individual, whether the individual can be identified directly or by combining that information with other data.

sections.title: Types of Personal Data
paragraphs: Information processed in connection with our website may include:
items: Account and contact information, such as name, email address, WhatsApp number, gender, and delivery address.
Order and service information, such as purchases, delivery details, payment references, and customer-support requests.
Preferences, such as notification settings and newsletter registrations.
Technical information, such as session cookies and information recorded by the web server, which may include IP address and browser information.

sections.title: Purposes of Personal Data Processing
paragraphs: We use information as needed for the following purposes:
items: Processing orders, payment verification, and delivery.
Providing customer support and responding to return or refund requests.
Maintaining service security and preventing misuse.
Handling newsletter and notification preferences and sharing product information where requested.

sections.title: Storage and Security of Personal Data
paragraphs: Account and order information is stored in the database used by ARÔME HOUSE. Passwords are stored as hashes. Access to management functions is restricted to authorized administrator accounts.
We apply safeguards appropriate to the website and its hosting environment. No system can guarantee absolute security. Contact us if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

sections.title: Your Rights as a Personal Data Subject
paragraphs: You may request information about your personal data, corrections, or deletion. Profile information can be updated through account settings, and further requests can be submitted to Customer Support.

You may also contact us to object to certain uses of your data or update your communication preferences. Requests will be reviewed in light of applicable requirements and information that must be retained for legitimate order or recordkeeping purposes.

sections.title: Personal Data Processing Period
paragraphs: Data is processed for as long as it is needed to provide the services described in this policy, maintain relevant business records, and meet applicable obligations. Some transaction or audit records may need to be retained after an account or order is removed.
The website uses session cookies to maintain login and shopping-cart state. External resources, such as fonts, icon assets, or maps, may make requests to their respective providers when loaded.

sections.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This policy may be updated as services and data-handling practices change. The latest version is available through the Privacy Policy link on the ARÔME HOUSE website.

sections.title: Contact Information
paragraphs: Contact ARÔME HOUSE Customer Support for questions, corrections, or requests relating to personal data.
